get_detector_model_by_name: get a DetectorModel subclass by name from the DetectorModelRegistry using get_detector_model_by_name
get_registry: get the full registry of registered DetectorModel subclasses using DetectorModelRegistry.get_registry
detector: run the detector method on a Detector subclass to find change points in time series data
remover: remove detected outliers from time series data with optional linear interpolation using the remover method
fit_predict: fit a DetectorModel on time series data and predict anomaly scores using the fit_predict method
